x: Pam and John married in 1960 and for these two setting up home together was not going to cramp their athletic style. Although he was not racing so much John was often encouraged by Pam to get out for a run.

John Stow and Pam were married in September with many Belgravians present. It seems confusion was caused by Gordon Biscoe handing out numbers and pins at the reception while Colin Pearson spent half the time looking for the changing rooms!
John too had family support for Pam and the boys were at the track to welcome him in. It was good to see another Davies family supporting the lads, Stan (up to town from Suffolk) and Dai.
